♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.3.0 APUE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

**MAP RIGS 2.0**, AutoCaptions a **Your script** ne **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** ka ho, ne **Flex Studio (Beta)** a edi kan download, na ɛbisa wo ansa na ɛde ne ho ahyɛ mu.

*(De hyɛ version a wowɔ seesei no so, na san bue After Effects prɛko pɛ.)*

♦️ **Foforɔ: MAP RIGS 2.0**
* **Map desk** nhyehyɛeɛ no, beaeɛ hwehwɛ a intanɛt nhia, **Quick looks** (Country Pop, Space Dive, Trip Route ne deɛ ɛkeka ho), Stick to Map, Clean labels, Always Sharp, map styles a wontua hwee ne **Open in Flex Maps**.
* Ne nnwinnadeɛ a ɛka ho (live sync, styles, labels, 3D, Finalize) bue ampa wɔ After Effects mu seesei.

♦️ **Deɛ ɛyɛ foforɔ wɔ AutoCaptions mu**
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, ɛde Flex AI credits di dwuma) ne engine a yɛkamfo kyerɛ, na yɛapaw no prɛko ama obiara. Paw Whisper bio na fa yɛ captions kwa wɔ wo kɔmputa so (Translate To hia Whisper). Sɛ server no so abu a, ɛkyerɛ wo baabi a wowɔ wɔ santen no mu.
* **Your script**: captions no fa ne nsɛmfua ne ne kyerɛwbea wɔ baabiara a wokaa saa nsɛmfua no.
* **Editable template** output: captions no bɛyɛ template layers a wobɛtumi asesa wɔn style wɔ Essential Properties mu (After Effects 2026).
* Wompaw hwee, na Source media nso yɛ hunu? Ɛde **composition no nyinaa** ma wo. Audio koro no ara san de ne transcript no di dwuma.

♦️ **Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** download app no, afei ɛbisa **Install / Not now**.
* App no (2.0.0-beta.2): **PRO, TRACK, ROTOSCOPE, COLOR GRADING** adwumayɛbea, tool keys te sɛ After Effects deɛ, clips bue ntɛm ara, na OPEN nso yɛ adwuma wɔ precomps ne adjustment layers so.

♦️ **Yɛasiesie**
* Theme effects a na ɛyera wɔ Windows PC pii so no asan aba (ɛyɛ hare sɛ wɔadum Windows animation effects a).

♦️ **Wo beaeɛ, sɛ wopɛ a, de bɔ wo license ho ban**
* Yɛbisa prɛko pɛ, na ɛyɛ wo pɛ: sɛ wopaw **No thanks** a, biribiara kɔ so yɛ adwuma. Sesa no wɔ **Flex Settings > Privacy** mu. Yɛkora no asram 12, yɛntɔn da, na yɛmfa mma obiara da, gye sɛ mmara hwehwɛ saa.

ult.message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V2.3.0 APUE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Caption Stack atu akɔ AutoCaptions mu** a styles ma asɛmfua biara, nhyehyɛeɛ, nkanyan ne nnyigyeɛ ka ho. **UN-NEST** ne blend modes yɛ adwuma wɔ Premiere 26.5 so, **AUTO CUT** yɛ mmiaeɛ baako pɛ, na **Flex Studio (Beta)** bue wo clip firi panel no so.

*(De hyɛ version a wowɔ seesei no so, na san bue Premiere Pro prɛko pɛ.)*

♦️ **Foforɔ: Captions a ɛkanyan wɔ AutoCaptions mu**
* **Asɛmfua style**: ma asɛmfua biara ne ankasa kɔla, font ne Flat, Shine anaa Glow finish.
* **Nkyerɛwsɛm nhyehyɛeɛ**: Stack, Over, Under, Beside ne Line.
* **Nkanyan ma asɛmfua biara** (Fade, Pop, Rise, Type, Shake ne deɛ ɛkeka ho) a preview ka ho, ne **Pop / Tick / Swoosh** nnyigyeɛ nso. Asɛmfua styles ne nkanyan hia **Images** output no.
* **Gemini 3.5 Transcribe** (cloud, ɛde Flex AI credits di dwuma) ne engine a yɛkamfo kyerɛ seesei, na yɛapaw no prɛko ama obiara; paw Whisper engine na fa yɛ captions kwa a intanɛt nhia.
* **Your script** (Captions mode): captions no fa ne nsɛmfua wɔ baabi a wokaa saa nsɛmfua no.
* Sɛ wompaw hwee a (Source card no yɛ hunu), ɛde **timeline no nyinaa** ma wo; wɔkora captions no wɔ wo project no nkyɛn.

♦️ **Foforɔ: Flex Studio (Beta)**
* **Open in Flex Studio** di clip no akyi wɔ app no mu; **APPLY TO PREMIERE** de track no san bre wo. Wonhyɛɛ mu ɛ? **Download Flex Studio (Beta)** download no, afei ɛbisa **Install / Not now**.

♦️ **Nsakraeɛ**
* **AUTO CUT** hwehwɛ clip a woapaw no mu, na ɛtwa no mmiaeɛ baako pɛ. **Retakes** hu nsɛm a wosan fii ase kaeɛ.
* **Audio Studio** wɔ sub-tabs nsia. **Library** no wɔ Nest Saver mu seesei.

♦️ **Yɛasiesie**
* **UN-NEST** wɔ Premiere 26.5 so (na ɛpo nest biara), ne blend modes te sɛ Screen a na ɛsan kɔ Normal (Premiere wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu).
* **AUTOSAVE 0:00** chip kɔkɔɔ no, Caption Stack preview tuntum no, ne theme effects a na ɛyera wɔ Windows PC pii so.

♦️ **Wo beaeɛ, sɛ wopɛ a, de bɔ wo license ho ban**
* Yɛbisa prɛko pɛ, na ɛyɛ wo pɛ: sɛ wopaw **No thanks** a, biribiara kɔ so yɛ adwuma. Sesa no wɔ **Flex Settings > Privacy** mu. Yɛkora no asram 12, yɛntɔn da, na yɛmfa mma obiara da, gye sɛ mmara hwehwɛ saa.
